title: Corporate Law AI Web Application
desc:
I need an AI-powered web application that focuses exclusively on corporate law. The system must be able to:

• Offer conversational, context-aware legal advice on corporate matters.
• Draft standard corporate documents (NDAs, shareholder agreements, board resolutions, etc.) from user-supplied prompts.
• Run quick legal research queries, surfacing up-to-date statutes, regulations, and relevant case summaries.

Core expectations  
I want a browser-based interface that feels like a chat assistant. Under the hood, you are free to combine GPT-4 (or another large language model), retrieval-augmented generation, and any open-source legal datasets you deem reliable—so long as citations are provided for every answer. Accuracy, traceability, and plain-English explanations are critical.

Key deliverables  
1. Responsive front-end with secure user authentication.  
2. Back-end that routes user queries to the AI engine, distinguishes between advice, drafting, and research tasks, and returns formatted results.  
3. A lightweight administration panel where I can update prompt templates and upload new corporate-law reference materials.  
4. Full source code, deployment instructions, and a short video walkthrough.

Acceptance criteria  
• Advice responses cite at least three authoritative sources.  
• Generated documents are ready to download as Word or PDF.  
• Research mode returns links to statutes and cases, organised by jurisdiction.  
• System deployed to my cloud account and passes a b

title: Kids Channel Growth Strategist
desc:
I recently launched Aksa Studio, an original kids’ music and animation IP. Sixteen polished videos are already live on YouTube and the tracks are distributed worldwide, so production is done—I now need someone who will OWN growth for the next 30 days and, if the pilot succeeds, beyond.

Top priority  
My immediate focus is audience development with a clear emphasis on accelerating subscriber growth in our core English-speaking markets: the US, the UK and India. Everything else you do—SEO, metadata, thumbnails, Shorts/Reels repurposing—should feed that goal.

Scope of work  
• Optimise every existing video, playlist and channel element for YouTube SEO, including compelling titles, keyword-rich descriptions and eye-catching thumbnails.  
• Repurpose long-form content into Shorts/Reels and schedule them for maximum reach across YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and any additional platform you recommend.  
• Build and maintain country-specific playlists, partner channels or collabs that drive qualified parents and kids to our catalogue.  
• Track analytics daily, translate the numbers into actionable insights and supply a concise weekly growth report that highlights subscriber gains, watch-time movement and retention curves.  
• Suggest new experiments or A/B tests as data dictates.

Pilot parameters  
This is a paid 30-day pilot I’d like to kick off ASAP. If you deliver measurable subscriber growth and clear strategic direction, we can discuss a rolling monthly engagement.

title: AI Brand Awareness Video Creation
desc:
I want to boost my brand’s visibility through compelling AI-driven video content. The goal is simple: create short, attention-grabbing videos that will circulate on social channels and reinforce who we are and what we stand for. Because I’m focused on brand awareness, every clip needs to look polished, on-message, and unmistakably ours.

Here’s what I need from you: conceive, script if necessary, and produce a series of AI videos—think the modern, synthetic-media style made possible with tools like Synthesia, Runway, or any platform you’re comfortable with. The final edits should be ready to post (preferably in 1080×1080 and 1920×1080) and include light motion graphics, captions, and subtle branding elements so the audience instantly recognizes us.

Deliverables  
• 3 finished AI videos, 30–60 seconds each, formatted for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts  
• Source files or project links so future tweaks are possible  
• A brief usage guide outlining recommended hashtags, posting cadence, and thumbnail suggestions

Acceptance criteria  
The videos must stay on-brand in color, typography, and tone; run glitch-free on all major platforms; and pass a quick review for clarity and engagement before final hand-off.

If you have a showreel or examples of past AI video work, include them so I can gauge style fit. Looking forward to seeing your creative approach.

title: AI Video Shorts Automation
desc:
I want a single AI-powered workflow that turns my raw footage or text prompts into entertainment-style YouTube Shorts, polishes longer videos, and then posts everything automatically to both YouTube and Instagram. 

Here’s what matters to me:
• The agent must be able to create Shorts from scratch or from supplied clips, matching the fast-paced, hook-heavy style that performs well in the entertainment niche.  
• Built-in editing should cover subtitles, music or sound-effect beds, and eye-catching visual effects without manual touch-ups.  
• Once a video or Short is rendered, the system should handle captions, thumbnails, descriptions, hashtags, and publish or schedule posts on both platforms through their APIs.  

I’m open to whatever stack you prefer—whether that’s Python scripts with ffmpeg, OpenAI/Whisper for transcription, or a no-code automation platform—as long as the final result is reliable and repeatable. 

Acceptance criteria  
1. I can drop footage or a prompt into a folder or dashboard and receive an edited Short and/or full video.  
2. Subtitles are accurate, timed correctly, and styled to brand guidelines.  
3. Music/SFX and visual effects are synced and royalty-safe.  
4. The finished asset appears on my YouTube and Instagram accounts with the right metadata, either immediately or at a scheduled time I choose.  

Deliver the source code, configuration notes, and a quick screen-share demo to prove the pipeline works end to end.

title: Social Media & Store Operations Assistant
desc:
I need a reliable hand to run Kaak Alia’s online counter each day and turn Instagram traffic into paid orders. Your focus will be Instagram management—planning the feed, publishing stories, and pushing targeted ads through Meta Ads Manager—while keeping every DM and WhatsApp message answered quickly so no sale is missed.

Alongside the customer chat you’ll log each order, note the day’s ad spend, and keep a simple Google Sheets dashboard so I can see what worked and what didn’t. Every Sunday I’ll expect a clear performance summary: reach, spend, orders, and any insights that can shape the next week’s content.

I’m particularly interested in freelancers whose strongest skill set is Social Media & Store Operations assistance. If you’ve managed accounts for food, bakery, or e-commerce brands, that’s an added plus.

When you apply, please skip the long proposal and simply send:
• Links to Instagram accounts you have managed (live or archived)  
• A line or two about the results you achieved with Meta ads or daily ops on those accounts  

Acceptance criteria for the role:
• Posts, stories, and sponsored ads scheduled one week ahead for approval  
• DMs and WhatsApp inquiries answered  
• Weekly report delivered every Sunday, clear and actionable  

If you thrive on fast-paced social media work and enjoy sweet success metrics, let’s talk.

title: Cold Call Appointment Setter
desc:
I need a confident phone-pro who can jump straight into small-business outreach and book qualified second meetings for me. The exact niche is up to you—if you feel most comfortable with local retail shops, service providers, restaurants or cafés, go for it. The only requirement is that the owner or decision maker is on the line and agrees to a follow-up conversation about our advertising / website solution.

Your call should be short and purposeful. The goal is not to pitch every feature but to confirm interest, verify they have a real need, and lock in a specific date and time for a deeper product demo with me. No long spiels; just enough to prove value and secure the calendar slot.

What I’m looking for in your bid  
• A brief note highlighting past work in outbound calling or appointment setting (sample results, industries contacted, conversion rates—anything that shows you can deliver).  
• Your expected number of calls or appointments per week and your process for tracking them.  

Deliverables  
1. A shared call log (Google Sheet or similar) with numbers dialed, outcome and notes.  
2. Calendar invites for every confirmed second meeting.  

That’s it—quick, focused and results-driven. If you thrive on the phone and know how to turn a cold lead warm in under two minutes, let’s talk.

title: Vidyarthi Dincharya Niyojan -- 2
desc:
मुझे स्कूल-जाने वाले विद्यार्थियों के लिए एक ऐसा दैनिक टाइम-टेबल तैयार करवाना है जिसमें पढ़ाई और होमवर्क को सबसे ज़्यादा समय मिले, विशेषकर Languages विषय के writing skills पर फोकस के साथ।  

मैंने अपनी मौजूदा रूपरेखा (सुबह 4-6 रीविजन, 6-7 तैयारियाँ, 7-9 होमवर्क, 9-10 स्कूल-तैयारी, 10-4 स्कूल, 4-6 आराम, 6-8 पढ़ाई, 8-9 रात का खाना, 9-11 पढ़ाई, 11-4 नींद) साझा की है। इसे आधार मानकर आप इसे:  
• ज़्यादा प्रभावी अध्ययन स्लॉट्स में री-डिज़ाइन करें  
• लेखन कौशल सुधारने वाली एक्टिविटी-ब्लॉक्स (जर्नलिंग, निबंध-प्रैक्टिस, स्पेल-चेक रिव्यू) जोड़ें  
• छोटे-छोटे ब्रेक और माइक्रो-रेस्ट को तर्कसंगत ढंग से पिरोएँ ताकि थकान न हो  
• सुबह और रात के सेशन्स के लिए टॉपिक-वार प्राथमिकता सुझाएँ (ग्रामर, क्रिएटिव राइटिंग, रीडिंग नोट्स इत्यादि)  
• PDF या Google Sheet दोनों फॉर्मेट में सौंपें, ताकि आसानी से प्रिंट और एडिट हो सके  

सफल डिलिवरेबल होगा:  
1. दिनभर का मिनट-दर-मिनट शेड्यूल (वर्कडेज़ वीकेंड दोनों)  
2. प्रत्येक स्लॉट का उद्देश्य और अपेक्षित आउटपुट  
3. भाषा-लेखन सुधार के लिए साप्ताहिक माइक्रो-गोल्स व-ट्रैकर  
4. त्वरित पालन-योग्य टिप्स (Pomodoro, active recall, mind mapping)  

यदि आपके पास कोई अतिरिक्त अध्ययन-टूल या ऐप (Notion, Google Calendar, Forest) इंटीग्रेशन का सुझाव है तो खुशी से शामिल करें। मुझे व्यावहारिक, पालन-योग्य और लचीला शेड्यूल चाहिए जिसे छात्र तत्काल अमल में ला सकें।

title: India WhatsApp Bulk Messaging API
desc:
I need access to a reliable WhatsApp API account that can legally operate from India and let me push out large-scale marketing campaigns. Each blast will combine short promotional text with an attached video, so the solution must fully support media messages without compression issues or delays.  

My workflow is simple: I will manually paste or type each recipient number before sending, so I’m not looking for CRM integrations right now—just a clean interface or endpoint where numbers can be entered in batches and dispatched immediately.

Key expectations:  
• API or panel must originate in India and comply with WhatsApp policies.  
• Unlimited or high-volume throughput suitable for periodic campaign bursts.  
• Successful delivery reporting, basic analytics (delivered / failed), and an opt-out mechanism.  
• Clear instructions for authentication, message formatting, and media upload limits.  

Please outline how quickly you can provision the account, any daily sending caps, and the steps I’ll follow to get up and running. If you have a live demo or screenshots, that will speed up my decision.

title: WhatsApp Bulk Messaging API Setup
desc:
I need help getting full, reliable access to the WhatsApp Business API so I can send large-volume promotional messages to my current customer list. The goal is straightforward: promote my physical products to existing buyers with well-timed, compliant broadcasts that keep delivery costs low and engagement high.  

Here is what I am looking for:  
• End-to-end assistance obtaining and activating an official WhatsApp API number (or a vetted third-party provider) that can handle high daily throughput.  
• Guidance on message template approval, opt-in requirements, and any Indian regulations that apply so every blast stays within Meta policy.  
• A simple dashboard, script, or Postman collection I can reuse to upload CSV contact lists, personalise messages, and track delivery and read receipts.  
• Clear hand-off documentation so my team can continue scheduling campaigns without outside help.  

I prefer working with someone familiar with Indian telecom rules and high-volume sender reputation, but I’m open to the best solution that lets me launch quickly and scale smoothly. If you’ve already set up similar product-promotion flows for Indian businesses, please tell me how you handled onboarding, template approvals, and daily send limits.  

Deliverables will be considered complete once a test batch of messages reaches at least 95 % of my existing customers and I can replicate the process on my own.

title: WhatsApp API Account Setup
desc:
I need an expert who can walk me through securing an official WhatsApp Business API account—directly with Meta, not through any third-party reseller. The account will be used for high-volume promotional broadcasts aimed at boosting sales, so template approval and compliance with Meta’s policies are critical.

Scope of work
• Complete application and verification inside Facebook Business Manager.  
• Configure the number on WhatsApp Cloud API (or on-premise if that proves more suitable).  
• Set up one sample promotional template and prove message delivery to at least 1,000 opted-in contacts.  
• Provide clear, repeatable steps so my in-house team can scale campaigns on our own afterward.

Acceptance criteria
1. Business Manager and phone number fully approved and live on API.  
2. Promotional template submitted, approved, and delivered without rate-limiting or flag.  
3. Brief hand-off document covering daily sending limits, opt-in best practices, and compliance pointers.

Only freelancers based in India will be considered. When you respond, focus on your hands-on experience obtaining WhatsApp API approvals and running large promotional pushes; no need for lengthy proposals.
